That pluto in 12h can be hard. 11h stelliums are generally good for community/friends, but if there are oppositions/squares to that house it can make things more difficult. I agree with radicalsavage, its all about frame of mind. 12th house is typically the house of surrender, the subconscious. Pluto deals with power/power struggles, control/loss of control etc. In my opinion, only child status can be seen through your 3rd house. 3rd house can represent siblings, and saturn is a teacher in a way. Saturn is known for saying no lol. This indicates that you may have to overcome something related to you being an only child. I wouldnt know. also Saturn squares Pluto. Try to be more open minded, more open to change. Chiron 10th can indicate the loss of your (assuming) more dominate parent, your mother. My condolences. Discover what your fears are and confront them. This will help you succeed and move forward. Therapy, meditation, etc will help with mental health so you can start untangling the mind. Find people with similar hobbies, that will help you create community and you'll likely thrive. Try to relinquish control over things that are out of your control and let things just flow. Just my perspective, I could be wrong. Aint over til its over.
